name: HSPT Cut and Gaussian Loading Optimization
definition: Optimizing the HSPT cut and Gaussian loading by storing SPT properties in a continuous GPU buffer and transferring Gaussians via a single copy operation, reorganizing them on the GPU into a Structure of Arrays (SoA) layout.
summary: HSPT Cut and Gaussian Loading Optimization reduces RAM-to-GPU transfer latency by storing hierarchical metadata on the GPU and transferring visible Gaussian data via a single bulk copy followed by GPU-side reorganization.
